title: Broker Constitutional Object Ownership and Custody Series
scope: constitutional ownership and custody doctrine only

b02_001_object_inventory.ownership_authority: Trader creates execution intent; Broker may validate, translate, and preserve request evidence only.
Broker may consume redacted credential references but shall not own or expose secrets.
Broker owns broker-protocol translation inside the Broker boundary.
Broker preserves raw external responses and normalizes them; Broker shall not rewrite external truth.
Broker owns canonical normalization of broker communication events.
Broker owns deterministic mapping between ARGOS and broker identifiers.
Broker owns anomaly classification and case-file generation for Broker communication anomalies.
Broker owns broker capability registration, compatibility evidence, and supported execution-surface declarations.
Broker owns broker health observation, status recording, and anomaly routing.
Broker owns communication anomaly classification within the Broker boundary.
Broker owns adapter registration and compatibility gatekeeping; live adapter approval remains outside initial certification scope.
Broker owns append-only message custody history for Broker communications.
Trader owns execution intent; Broker owns translation, admissibility response, and broker event evidence.
Broker owns paper broker order lifecycle state while Performance Truth and Position Registry own downstream truth surfaces.
Broker owns fill event generation for paper broker execution; position mutation remains externally owned.
Broker may consume account availability for paper execution but shall not establish authoritative account truth.
Broker may consume authoritative market state for execution feasibility but shall not become market-data authority.
Broker produces source events; Performance Truth owns the authoritative performance ledger.

b02_001_ownership_authority_registry.authority: Owns canonical broker communication, translation, normalization, Broker-owned paper execution state, broker event evidence, anomaly case files, adapter compatibility records, health observations, identifier mappings, and message history.
Owns trade intent, execution request authorization, order-management intent objects, and paper order tickets until transferred into Broker custody for execution handling.
Owns raw broker facts and external execution venue responses; Broker preserves and normalizes without rewriting external truth.
Owns account balances, cash, buying power, settlement truth, collateral, and broker account financial state.
Owns market observations consumed by Broker execution feasibility checks.
Owns authoritative performance truth and broker ledger projection after Broker events are admitted.
Owns credentials and secrets; Broker may hold redacted references only.

b02_002_custody_registry.custody_rule: Broker custody is deterministic, evidence-bearing, and bounded to broker communication and execution-event handling.
Credential material remains outside Broker custody; Broker receives reference-only authentication context.
Financial truth remains outside Broker custody except for immutable dependency evidence references.
Market truth remains outside Broker custody except for immutable dependency evidence references.
Performance truth projection remains downstream of Broker source-event production.

b02_002_lifecycle_authority_registry.modification_authority: Broker Office within immutable append-or-replace rules
b02_002_lifecycle_authority_registry.activation_authority: Broker Office after Trader authorization and dependency validation
b02_002_lifecycle_authority_registry.suspension_authority: Broker Office or Enterprise Governance for broker-boundary failures
b02_002_lifecycle_authority_registry.destruction_authority: Prohibited for constitutional evidence; supersession only
Prohibited where immutable evidence is required

b02_002_custody_transition_registry.transition: Trader order intent to Broker request custody
b02_002_custody_transition_registry.trigger: authorized execution request submitted to Broker boundary
b02_002_custody_transition_registry.evidence_required: execution request identifier, workflow token, order id, correlation id, authority references

b02_002_custody_transition_registry.transition: External broker response to Broker evidence custody
b02_002_custody_transition_registry.evidence_required: raw payload hash, broker order id, response type, timestamp

b02_002_custody_transition_registry.transition: Broker event to downstream truth custody
b02_002_custody_transition_registry.evidence_required: event id, order id, fill id if present, content hash, source authority

b02_003_ownership_transfer_registry.rule: Broker custody shall not imply ownership transfer from Trader, Financial Authority, Market Data Authority, external brokers, Performance Truth, Position Registry, or Historian.
Permanent transfer of Broker-owned constitutional objects requires Broker Governance Authority and Enterprise Governance approval.
Temporary custody may be delegated to Historian for preservation and to certification tooling for read-only audit, without mutation authority.

b02_003_custody_delegation_registry.revocation: not permitted for immutable evidence already admitted

b02_003_custody_delegation_registry.delegated_custody: storage, replay, backup, and recovery substrate

b02_003_cross_office_custody_registry.relationship: Trader owns order intent and authorized execution request; Broker owns broker communication and event evidence.
Risk owns risk approval truth; Broker consumes risk authority references only.
Authorizations owns execution authorization truth; Broker consumes authorization references only.
Broker emits source events; Performance Truth owns admitted performance ledger state.
Broker emits fills; Position Registry owns position mutation and position lifecycle state.
Historian preserves immutable Broker evidence after custody transfer.
Infrastructure owns durable storage, replay substrate, backup, and recovery mechanics.

b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.conflict: Broker event conflicts with external broker raw response
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.winner: External broker raw response for external fact; Broker canonical event must be corrected or superseded
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.evidence_required: raw response hash, canonical event id, discrepancy record

b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.conflict: Broker event conflicts with Performance Truth ledger
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.winner: Broker source event for broker fact; Performance Truth owns ledger correction process
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.evidence_required: event id, ledger entry id, reconciliation case

b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.conflict: Broker account snapshot conflicts with Financial Authority state
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.evidence_required: account snapshot reference and financial reconciliation object

b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.conflict: Broker market state conflicts with Market Data Authority
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.evidence_required: market state reference and source observation

b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.winner: Enterprise Governance until explicit ownership amendment is adopted
b02_003_custody_conflict_resolution_regi.evidence_required: affected object, competing owners, doctrine references

b02_004_ownership_integrity_registry.check: every object has exactly one constitutional owner
externally owned objects are explicitly identified
custody does not imply ownership transfer

b02_004_final_constitutional_ownership_b.summary: Broker owns canonical broker communication, translation, normalization, paper broker execution state, broker event evidence, anomaly evidence, adapter compatibility records, health observations, identifier mappings, and message history. Broker does not own Trader execution intent, credentials, market data truth, financial account truth, Performance Truth ledger state, Position Registry state, or external broker truth.
